units.source_text: 再说，真一身旁有四五个老太婆，她们一边打开多层方木盒，一边闲聊天。

en.t: Besides, there were four or five old women beside Shinichi, chatting idly as they opened a multi-tiered square wooden box.

units.source_text: 也许真一是对这些老太婆感到亲切，起先是挨着她们坐，后来才躺下的吧。

en.t: Perhaps Shinichi felt at ease with these old women; at first he sat close beside them, and only later lay down.
